From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Commander brief: QBR account drilldowns & forecast consolidation

Team —

Two quick aims for this thread:
1) Lock account-by-account owners and one-line risk/status for the Acme Corp QBR packet.
2) Consolidate the forecast numbers for the board backup deck (I need a single rollup by tomorrow EOD PST).

I attached the QBR_account_rollup_template.xlsx — use the 'owner' column and the 'confidence' flag. Please do not alter the doc structure; add rows for any new contacts.

Immediate asks:
- Marissa: take lead on commercial health + renewal timeline; add the mutual action plan summary into the MAP tab.
- Ben: validate technical blockers and security/compliance gating with the customer (SOC2 docs + KMS questions).
- Laura: consolidate ACV / committed ARR and confirm the forecast category (Commit / Commit at Risk / Best Case).
- Karthik: run a quick sensitivity on quota achievement if ACME slips 30d; highlight where we lose enough ARR to impact the QBR narrative.

Deadline: populate the spreadsheet and post a one-paragraph summary per account in this thread by 17:00 PST tomorrow (2027-03-10). I will synthesize for the exec brief on Friday.

Attach: QBR_account_rollup_template.xlsx, ACME_MAP_v2.pdf

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Tessa —

Confirming: I will take ownership of the commercial health narrative and the MAP. Quick notes from my side after yesterday's sync with ACME ops:
- Renewal window: 2027-05-15 (contract auto-renews, but they want new SLAs for latency).
- Exec sponsor: Priya Singh (Head of Platform) — she requested a 30-min pre-QBR tech run-through.
- Risk signals: increased use of 3rd-party inference layer internally (signals lower adoption of our dedicated product).

Action plan: I'll update the MAP tab and add a 2-3 line red/amber/green status on the 'owner' row. Will ping external-sales-ops@acme.io for the latest invoice/payment confirmation (to verify ARR).

Attachments: none

-Marissa

Quick technical check-in: I spoke with Marco Ruiz (CloudOps at Acme) this morning. Summary:
- Compliance ask: they want KV cache encryption end-to-end and HSM integration for key rotation — they've flagged this as a gating item for Dedicated capacity.
- SOC2 evidence: they asked for our latest SOC2 Type II report and proof of retention policy (they need retention windows documented).

I'll own the security/compliance row and will attach a short evidence packet by EOD tomorrow. Looping Marco: Marco — can you confirm the exact retention window they require?

Attachment to add: pricing-exhibit_redwood_2027.pdf (I will attach after legal confirms the copy).

-Ben

Team —

I've pulled the ACV numbers from billing and updated the 'finance' tab in the template. Key points:
- Committed ARR: $1.2M (renewal flagged as "Targeted" since pricing exhibit still in negotiation).
- Payment status: last invoice posted 2027-01-20, outstanding PO confirmation from ACME purchasing.
- Forecast category recommendation: Move $300k to Commit at Risk until PO clears.

I'll attach the exported billing ledger snippet into the Drive folder. Marissa — can you confirm whether we want to escalate the invoice to Collections or keep it as procurement follow-up?

-Laura

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Folks —

Ran the sensitivity (30d slip) and the topline impact:
- If ACME slips 30 days on the renewal, shortfall = $250k ARR for Q2.
- That shortfall pushes our sales attainment to 86% against plan for the segment (down from 92%).
- The biggest concentration is in the dedicated capacity upsell (60% of the at-risk ARR).

Recommendation: classify $250k as Commit at Risk, escalate pricing finale with legal to accelerate PO. I'll populate the 'risk model' tab in the template.

-Karthik

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Commander brief: QBR account drilldowns & forecast consolidation

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Synthesis below (will circulate to execs Friday AM):

Executive summary (one paragraph): Acme Corp is a strategic mid-market account with $1.2M committed ARR. Renewal target 2027-05-15; current risks center on pricing SLAs and two compliance asks (KV encryption + HSM rotation). We recommend classifying $300k as Commit at Risk pending PO confirmation and moving $250k to short-term risk if the renewal slips 30 days. Sales/CS owner: Marissa Cole.

Per-account drilldown (one-liners):
- Acme Corp (owner: Marissa Cole): Renewal 2027-05-15; commercial health = Amber; primary ask = revised latency SLAs + pricing exhibit.
- ACME infra (tech lead: Marco Ruiz): Security gating = High; needs SOC2 evidence and HSM roadmap.

Action items (owners + due):
- Marissa: finalize MAP tab + schedule pre-QBR run-through with Priya (owner) — due 2027-03-12 EOD.
- Ben: assemble SOC2 + retention evidence pack — due 2027-03-10 EOD.
- Laura: confirm $300k moved to Commit at Risk in the finance rollup + provide billing export — done.
- Karthik: deliver risk sensitivity exports and updated 'risk model' tab — done.

Next steps: Marissa, please propose two 30-min slots for the Priya pre-brief; I will take the consolidated one-paragraph executive summary and craft the Friday exec note. Marco/Priya — please confirm retention window by EOD so Ben can close the evidence packet.

Attachments: consolidated QBR_account_rollup_template.xlsx (finalized), ACME_MAP_v2.pdf (updated)
